items.q: 1) Do you remove both manual and electric treadmills?
a: Yes, we remove all treadmill types – manual, electric, folding, and commercial models. Our team is equipped to handle any make, model, or condition. Whether functional or broken, we’ll safely remove it from your home or gym.

items.q: 2) How do you handle heavy or bulky treadmills?
a: Our professionals use specialized equipment like appliance dollies, moving straps, and ramps. We carefully disassemble when needed and protect your property during removal. No treadmill is too heavy for our trained crews and properly equipped trucks.

items.q: 3) What areas do you serve for Treadmill Removal Services?
a: We serve the entire GTA, including Toronto, Mississauga, Bolton, Vaughan, and surrounding areas. Contact us with your location, and we’ll confirm if we service your area. Most urban and suburban locations are covered.

items.q: 4) Can you disassemble the treadmill for removal?
a: Absolutely. Our technicians will professionally disassemble your treadmill as needed, removing belts, consoles, and frames. We bring all necessary tools and safely disconnect any electrical components before removal.

Yes. We recycle up to 90% of materials, including metals, electronics, and rubber components, through certified facilities. Working parts are donated when possible. We minimize landfill waste through responsible disposal practices.

items.q: 6) Do I need to clear a path for the removal team?
a: While we’ll handle all moving, clearing basic pathways helps ensure faster service. Please remove small obstacles if possible. Our team will protect floors and walls while moving your treadmill through tight spaces.

items.q: 7) How much notice is needed to schedule a treadmill pickup?
a: Same-day service is often available. For best scheduling, a 24-hour notice is ideal. We offer flexible appointments, including evenings and weekends to accommodate your schedule. Emergency removals can frequently be accommodated.
